EmailTemplate.name: Deprovision Notification
EmailTemplate.Body:
Hello,

A scheduled deprovision (sunset) action has been completed for the following identity: $!{identityName}

#if($roleName) #else #end
Identity $!{identityName}
Event type $!{eventType}
Role removed $!{roleName}
Application $!{applicationName}
Account $!{nativeIdentity}
Entitlement $!{attributeName} = $!{attributeValue}
Requested by $!{assigner}

This is an automated notification from IdentityIQ. No action is required.
EmailTemplate.Description: Sent by the Scheduled Assignment (sunset) workflow when a role or entitlement is deprovisioned. Args supplied by the workflow step: identityName, eventType, roleName, applicationName, nativeIdentity, attributeName, attributeValue, assigner.
EmailTemplate.Subject: #if($roleName)Access removed: role "$!{roleName}" from $!{identityName}#{else}Access removed: entitlement on $!{applicationName} from $!{identityName}#end
